import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
df['hour'] = df['datetime'].dt.hour
df['day_of_week'] = df['datetime'].dt.day_name()

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Sales by product category (top left)
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax1.bar(range(len(product_sales)), product_sales.values, color=plt.cm.Set3(np.arange(len(product_sales))/len(product_sales)))
ax1.set_xticks(range(len(product_sales)))
ax1.set_xticklabels(product_sales.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for i, (bar, value) in enumerate(zip(bars, product_sales.values)):
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + max(product_sales.values)*0.01,
             f'${value:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by hour of day (top middle)
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax2.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8)
ax2.fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3)
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax2.set_title('Sales Trend by Hour', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sales by age group (top right)
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                    startangle=90, colors=plt.cm.Pastel1(np.arange(len(age_sales))/len(age_sales)))
ax3.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Sales by size (middle left)
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_data = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum().reindex(size_order)
bars4 = ax4.bar(size_order, size_data.values, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1'])
ax4.set_xlabel('Size')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax4.set_title('Sales by Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

for bar, value in zip(bars4, size_data.values):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, height + max(size_data.values)*0.01,
             f'${value:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in (middle)
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
takeaway_counts = df['is_takeaway'].value_counts()
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
bars5 = ax5.bar(takeaway_labels, takeaway_counts.values, color=['#95E1D3', '#F38181'])
ax5.set_xlabel('Service Type')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax5.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Transactions', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

for bar, value in zip(bars5, takeaway_counts.values):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, height + max(takeaway_counts.values)*0.01,
             f'{value:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 6. Payment method distribution (middle right)
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
wedges6, texts6, autotexts6 = ax6.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                       startangle=90, colors=plt.cm.Set2(np.arange(len(payment_counts))/len(payment_counts)))
ax6.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts6:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 7. Average transaction value by age group (bottom left)

avg_transaction = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].mean().reindex(age_order)
bars7 = ax7.bar(age_order, avg_transaction.values, color=plt.cm.viridis(np.arange(len(age_order))/len(age_order)))
ax7.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax7.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)')
ax7.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xticklabels(age_order, rotation=45)
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

for bar, value in zip(bars7, avg_transaction.values):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax7.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, height + max(avg_transaction.values)*0.01,
             f'${value:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 8. Sales by day of week (bottom middle)
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
day_order = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday']
day_sales = df.groupby('day_of_week')['total'].sum().reindex(day_order)

ax8.set_xlabel('Day of Week')

ax8.set_xticklabels(day_order, rotation=45)
ax8.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

for bar, value in zip(bars8, day_sales.values):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax8.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, height + max(day_sales.values)*0.01,
             f'${value:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 9. Quantity distribution (bottom right)
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
quantity_counts = df['quantity'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars9 = ax9.bar(quantity_counts.index.astype(str), quantity_counts.values, color=plt.cm.spring(np.arange(len(quantity_counts))/len(quantity_counts)))
ax9.set_xlabel('Quantity')
